title: BNY, Citadel Securities test tokenized U.S. Treasuries to speed up Wall Street financing
summary: The transaction shows how blockchain-based government bonds could help trading firms move collateral faster between settlement and financing.

title: Crypto exchange MNX takes on OKX, Bitget offering pre-IPO futures for AI giants
summary: MNX is offering a different way to trade the future valuations of private AI companies, including OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek.

title: UK crypto trader says almost $800,000 lost in knife assault as wrench attacks proliferate
summary: A crypto trader in the U.K. claimed masked intruders stole nearly $800,000 in cryptocurrency at knifepoint, furthering concerns of "wrench attacks" spreading in the country.

title: South Korea blocks 27 crypto exchanges, including Bitmart and Kucoin
summary: The country’s regulators are stepping up their earlier restrictions on mobile apps to websites, targeting unregistered exchanges before investors report losses.

title: Federated Hermes joins Wall Street's tokenization push with plans for first onchain fund shares
summary: The $911 billion Pittsburgh-based asset manager is teaming up with Prometheum to bring blockchain-based share classes of its funds to traditional brokerage accounts.
